sistem-izleme-aciklama: Monitor your infrastructure 24/7 without interruption, receive instant notifications, and increase your operational efficiency.
monitoru-silmek-istediginize-emin-misini: Are you sure you want to delete the '{0}' monitor?
olay-kaydi-bulunmuyor: No incident records found. Indicates healthy system status.

tt-monitor-adi: The name given to identify the source to be monitored.
tt-url: The full address of the system or web page to be monitored.
tt-http-metodu: The method to use when making the request (Usually GET).
tt-beklenen-http-kodu: The successful response code required for the system to be considered up (e.g., 200).
tt-iletisim-grubu: Contacts to be notified when there is a system failure or recovery.
tt-kontrol-araligi: Determines how often the system will be checked in seconds.
tt-timeout: The maximum time to wait for the system to respond.
tt-maks-yanit-suresi: If the response time exceeds this value, the system is marked as slow (warning).
tt-tetikleme-suresi: The confirmation time to wait before sending an immediate notification in case of an error.
tt-ssl-uyari-esigi: Determines how many days before the SSL certificate expires a warning will be issued.
tt-aciklama: Optional additional notes regarding the monitor.
tt-aktif: Determines whether the monitor will run in the background.
tt-ssl-kontrolu-yap: If the URL is HTTPS, it checks the validity and expiration date of the certificate.
tt-saglik-detaylarini-oku: If the URL returns a Health Check JSON, it fetches the data and displays it in details.
kullanici-yonetimi-aciklama: Manage users and their permissions who have access to the system.
kullaniciyi-sil-onay: Are you sure you want to delete this user?
ilk-giris-sifre-degisim-uyarisi: The user must change their password on the first login.
rol-admin-aciklama: (Full access to everything in the system)
rol-editor-aciklama: (Management of monitor points and contact groups)
tt-24s-uptime: The ratio of successful checks (UP) to the total checks in the last 24 hours.
tt-stat-toplam: The total number of all active and inactive monitors (monitoring points) registered in the system.
tt-stat-up: The number of healthy systems that returned a successful response (e.g., HTTP 200) on their last check.
tt-stat-down: The number of currently offline systems that were unreachable or returned an error (e.g., HTTP 404, 500) on their last check.
tt-stat-olaylar: The total number of ongoing outages (DOWN) or warnings that have not been resolved yet. This number decreases when the system recovers.
tt-stat-uptime: The average uptime (UP) percentage of all monitors based on checks performed in the last 24 hours. Indicates overall system health.
tt-stat-yanit: The average response time of all currently working (UP) monitors. Reflects the overall speed of your systems.
iletisim-grubu-aciklama: Create a new group to receive notifications on system events.
tekrar-alarm-araligi-ipucu: 0 = send only the first time, do not send again.
